title: Romualdez camp: Ex-Speaker's suspension does not mean guilt
summary: MANILA, Philippines — The preventive suspension of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez does not mean he has been found guilty of plunder, especially since his trial is still ongoing, his camp said…

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The preventive suspension of former House Speaker Martin Romualdez does not mean he has been found guilty of plunder, especially since his trial is still ongoing, his camp said on Wednesday. Atty. Ade Fajardo, Romualdez’s counsel, said this a day after the Sandiganbayan Third Division imposed a 90-day preventive suspension against Romualdez in connection with the plunder case over alleged kickbacks from flood control projects. READ: Sandiganbayan suspends Martin Romualdez for 90 days Fajardo said the preventive suspension is mandated by law.
